items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: He was like Sam Bo. You know Sam Bo?

ctx.x: Always looking for a job, hoping to get a job.

Always looking around, everybody says, the corner player never showed up. You see Johnny with his corner walking around, stopping in the halls and all around. Said, there's Johnny. Come on in there, Johnny. Johnny shoot the pieces, he know. You know? Was he a good corner player boy? Well he was pretty good. He was like Sam Bo. You know Sam Bo? Yeah. Sam Bo, this, somebody behind him is alright. You know? And if he knows something, he gonna shoot it. Big belly, he gonna shoot what he knows. But what he don't know,…
